text.section: Except as otherwise provided in §§ 4.1-200 and 4.1-201, no person shall manufacture alcoholic beverages in the Commonwealth without being licensed under this subtitle to manufacture such alcoholic beverages. Nor shall any person, other than a brewery licensee or bottler's licensee, bottle beer for sale.
The presence of mash at an unlicensed distillery shall constitute manufacturing within the meaning of this section.
Any person convicted of a violation of this section shall be guilty of a Class 6 felony.
